context: A retired exec advises on team development
purpose: Teach: 長谷川/戸田/松下/原田/小島/大野/吉川/柴田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 長谷川くん、戸田くん、若い頃から器を見抜いていた。
lines.en: Hasegawa and Toda — I could see what they were made of even when they were young.
lines.style: Unhurried, reflective voice. Measured cadence, as if pulling up a memory from decades back. Slight pause after each name, letting the weight settle. Calm authority without performance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。松下さん、原田さんも、忠実に育ってくれました。
lines.en: Yes. Matsushita and Harada both grew into their responsibilities faithfully.
lines.style: Respectful but not flattering. Steady delivery. A slight nod in the voice — acknowledgment of shared understanding. Professional warmth, the tone of someone reporting something he's proud of.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 小島と大野は、海外で経験積めば、化ける。
lines.en: Kojima and Ono — they'll surprise you once they've accumulated overseas experience.
lines.style: Quieter, more forward-leaning. The voice of someone placing a quiet bet on the future. Small lift on the final phrase, not quite a question but an opening — potential waiting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 吉川さん、柴田さんは、地に着いた仕事ぶりで頼もしいです。
lines.en: Yoshikawa and Shibata — their work has real substance to it. That's what makes them dependable.
lines.style: Nod of approval in the voice. Firm and grounded, like pressing a stamp on paper. Not rushed, but weighted. The satisfaction of recognizing solid character.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 人を見続ける目、忘れるな。
lines.en: Don't ever lose that eye for people.
lines.style: Shift to gentle firmness. Direct but not harsh — a benediction and a charge. Lean slightly forward. Final word carries a faint echo, like a bell that lingers.
